verified_facts: CME instructs users to select a date and filter by product to see trading hours.
CME lists the 2026 Thanksgiving Globex holiday period as November 26-28, 2026.
CME lists the 2026 Christmas Globex holiday period as December 24-26, 2026.

verified_facts: Micro E-mini contracts including MNQ list CME Globex hours as 5:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Central Time, Sunday-Friday.

official_sources_reviewed.scope: Product-filtered CME Globex Futures schedule for MNQ, October 8-31, 2026
verified_facts: The MNQ product row was reviewed using the Full Calendar view, Futures product view, and MNQ search; overlapping date views covered October 8-31.
Normal MNQ Globex rows show a 16:00 CT close, 16:45 CT pre-open, and 17:00 CT next trade-date open.
The October 12, 2026 MNQ trade date follows regular Globex hours; no holiday closure or early close is shown.
October 31 is Saturday and has no MNQ session in the selected date view.

official_sources_reviewed.scope: CME Equity Index Globex intraday pause change
verified_facts: CME eliminated the 15-minute 15:15-15:30 CT pause from June 27, 2021; the affected equity-index futures trade Sunday-Friday 17:00-16:00 CT with 16:00-17:00 CT maintenance.
official_sources_reviewed.limitations: The notice excludes specified 250-multiplier S&P 500 products and BTIC/TACO; MNQ is not among those listed exceptions.
